text:
kevin: FYI deploy-bot stopped a canary publish for redwood/ingest-worker:2026.03.21-canary. Error: tag collision because staging tag already points to a newer digest in EU mirror. Can we decide fallback?

deploy-bot: [automation] publish blocked: tag_collision_detected
```ERROR: tag collision on eu-ecr mirror
image: redwood/ingest-worker:2026.03.21-canary
candidate_digest: sha256:1111aaaa2222bbbb
existing_digest: sha256:9999cccc8888dddd
suggested_action: hold_or-retag
```
tara: Is the existing_digest from a prior manual promote? If so we should not overwrite during change window.

ali: I see previous promote-7552 promoted 9999cccc... earlier today. That was a hotfix. We shouldn't implicit-retag.

kevin: Options: 1) hold and ask CI to repush a new tag (ugly), 2) manual pin to candidate_digest and force promote (risky), 3) abort and schedule for next change window. We go to change window at 22:00UTC.

oncall-ree: Rollback criteria if we force promote: revert tag to sha256:9999cccc... immediately if canary fails >3x errors in 10m. Our promote tool can revert tag quickly.

tara: Given this is a canary, leaning to hold and repush with a new tag (rc3) to avoid overwriting a hotfix digest. That keeps audit clean.

ali: Agree. Also file INF-2100 to capture why mirror tag collision happened - maybe delayed reconciliation.

kevin: OK holding. I'll cancel the promote and ask CI to trigger a republish as 2026.03.21-rc3. Tara please coordinate release note line about hotfix digest so we don't lose trace.

deploy-bot: [automation] promote canceled by kevin. Action: hold.

kevin: Action items: 1) CI republish as rc3 (ci-team). 2) Tara add release note: "rc2 skipped due to tag-collision with hotfix digest sha256:9999cccc..." 3) Ali file INF-2100 and link in notes.

tara: Noted. I'll update release notes and block rc2 from promotion window.

ali: INF-2100 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2100 - assigned to infra-mirror team.

kevin: Closing thread. Will reopen if mirror reconciliation completes or another decision needed.
